head: ec4518da560867e897c290ddf8abc3b2496a4b59
scope: Whole ui.notices namespace, all 93 keys, English vs fr at ec4518da56 (first audit). Read the English context sidecar entry for every key, the fr style guide and glossary, and the locale's existing namespaces for established terminology (credential=identifiant, backend, goal=objectif, draft=brouillon, highlights, session ID, dismiss=ignorer). Checked accuracy, idiom, vous register, glossary, ICU integrity, typography and rendered head+tail composition.
method: Mechanical: key-set equality and order; ICU parse of both sides with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser comparing argument names, plural variables, plural categories, select arms and number skeletons; rendering of every parameterised message at counts 0/1/2/5/21/1000000. Real path: bundled the worktree's src/i18n/index with esbuild and rendered the composed undo toasts and bulk-read receipts through the app's own t() in fr (drafts head+tail at 1/2/5/21, archive name+verb, markAllReadReceipt's join, unread_not_cleared with its reason clause). Typography: U+202F before : ; ! ? and inside guillemets, U+2019 apostrophes, no ASCII space before high punctuation, no English left except product/command/machine tokens (Local Operator, bash, /credential, /goal, hub, backend, Aida).

findings.current: {count, plural, one {1 conversation se trouve sur un autre appareil et sera effacée quand celui-ci se mettra à jour.} many {{count} de conversations se trouvent sur d’autres appareils et seront effacées quand ceux-ci se mettront à jour.} other {{count} conversations se trouvent sur d’autres appareils et seront effacées quand ceux-ci se mettront à jour.}}
findings.proposed: {count, plural, one {1 conversation se trouve sur un autre appareil et sera marquée comme lue quand celui-ci se mettra à jour.} many {{count} de conversations se trouvent sur d’autres appareils et seront marquées comme lues quand ceux-ci se mettront à jour.} other {{count} conversations se trouvent sur d’autres appareils et seront marquées comme lues quand ceux-ci se mettront à jour.}}
findings.reason: English says the unread MARK clears on the owning device, and the context note forbids reading it as a failure; French makes the CONVERSATION the subject of “effacer”, so a reader is told their conversation will be erased when another device updates — and “Conversation effacée” is exactly this catalogue's wording for a real conversation clear (ui.notices.sessions.cleared). The minimal fix is the verb alone; at count 2 the sentence also runs 103 characters against the English 60, so a shorter form (e.g. “elles seront marquées comme lues à leur mise à jour”) is available if the card overflows.
findings.evidence: Rendered through the real t() path in fr with markAllReadReceipt's own join: “5 conversations marquées comme lues. 2 conversations se trouvent sur d’autres appareils et seront effacées quand ceux-ci se mettront à jour.”

findings.current: {count, plural, one {1 conversation n’a pas pu être effacée et reste non lue.} many {{count} de conversations n’ont pas pu être effacées et restent non lues.} other {{count} conversations n’ont pas pu être effacées et restent non lues.}}
findings.proposed: {count, plural, one {1 conversation n’a pas pu être marquée comme lue ; elle reste non lue.} many {{count} de conversations n’ont pas pu être marquées comme lues ; elles restent non lues.} other {{count} conversations n’ont pas pu être marquées comme lues ; elles restent non lues.}}
findings.reason: “Could not be cleared” is about the unread mark, but “une conversation … n’a pas pu être effacée” reads as the conversation failing to be deleted; “reste non lue” contradicts that reading instead of preventing it. Same root cause as the MAJOR on mark_all_read_deferred.

findings.current: {reason} Les marques de non-lu n’ont pas été effacées.
findings.proposed: {reason} Les marques de lecture n’ont pas été retirées.
findings.reason: “marques de non-lu” is a calque of “unread marks” — no other fr key uses it (the locale's unread noun is “non lus”, ui.teamBridge.unread.count) — and “marques de lecture … retirées” is the idiomatic collocation.

findings.current: Les mises en avant n’ont pas pu être mises à jour.
findings.proposed: Impossible de mettre à jour la section À la une (or, if the surface is the file list rather than the section: “Les fichiers à la une n’ont pas pu être mis à jour.”)
findings.reason: Third rendering of one term: the same “Highlights” surface is “À la une” (ui.canvas.files.highlights, ui.canvas.finder_layout.highlights) and “Mis en évidence” (ui.library.status.highlighted), while this key invents the noun “mises en avant”; it also repeats “mises … mises” in one sentence.

findings.proposed: ID de session copié (and “Impossible de copier l’ID de session” in ui.notices.sessions.id_copy_failed), or record a locale-wide decision and change the two menu labels instead
findings.reason: Glossary drift on “Session ID” inside one interaction: the toast says “Identifiant de session” while the affordance that raises it (“Copier l’ID de session”, ui.chat.header.copy_id and ui.chat.sidebar.row_menu.copy_id) says “ID de session”; ui.canvas.variables_viewer uses “identifiant de session”, so the locale currently has both.

findings.proposed: Rien n’a été marqué comme lu.
findings.reason: As the lead of a receipt whose remainder sentences talk about conversations, “Rien n’a été effacé” can be read as “nothing was deleted”; naming the act removes the ambiguity. (ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_nothing, “Rien à effacer.”, is fine — its context is an empty queue, not data.)

observations.note: archiveOfferedName() hardcodes English curly quotes (“${title}”) in archive-undo.ts, so fr composes ““Revue trimestrielle” archivée.” rather than « Revue trimestrielle » archivée. Not a catalogue defect — the verb and the no-name noun are correct — but the locale-aware quoting belongs in the source (a keyed wrapper or a locale quote helper).

The four plain ask receipts in English end on a dangling preposition (“Answer sent to”, “Answer changed for”, “Declined the ask in”); they are used alone when the conversation name is unknown. fr supplies complete short phrases, which is the right call for the locale; the English source is what needs the follow-up.

All ten plural messages carry one/many/other (fr CLDR, no few), and the many branches use the partitive “de + noun” the style guide prescribes. The many category is unreachable in most of these surfaces but correct where it is reachable (config_run_*, credentials.*).
